sloka: तत्पुरा राम शारीरीमुपहिंसां तपस्विषु ।दर्शयन्ति हि दुष्टास्ते त्यक्ष्याम इममाश्रमम् ॥ २.११६.१९॥
transliteration: tatpurā rāma śārīrīmupahiṁsāṁ tapasviṣu ।darśayanti hi duṣṭāste tyakṣyāma imamāśramam ॥ 2.116.19॥

translations.english: O Rama, those vile creatures resort to physical violence against ascetics, we have therefore, resolved to quit this ashram.
